facts.text: Moffat was named after David H. Moffat, a railroad official who helped bring the Denver and Rio Grande Western line through the valley.
The town sprang up in 1890 when the San Luis Town and Improvement Company laid out a new settlement to serve the booming cattle‑shipping industry.
Every year the Moffat County Balloon Festival lights up the night sky, drawing visitors to live music, vendors, and the Colorado Cruisers Car Show.
An old church in Moffat stands as a quiet reminder of the town’s early settlers and their faith.
Hikers and nature lovers find some of Colorado’s most beautiful scenery near Moffat, from pristine public lands to the wild horses of Sand Wash Basin.
